title: Five systems worth reading
lead: A short selection of systems built around real data, model orchestration, runtime constraints, and user-facing delivery.

items.label: CASE I
items.title: Enterprise RAG & Contract Intelligence
items.summary: A grounded document platform for enterprise Q&A, web search, and contract workflows.
bullets: PDF/DOCX ingestion, parsing, chunking, embeddings, vector indexing, and object storage.
Hybrid retrieval, metadata filters, reranking, token-budgeted context, citations, and answer verification.
Agent tools, streamed responses, session history, async workers, monitoring, and local vLLM inference.

items.label: CASE II
items.title: Face Recognition Attendance System
items.summary: A camera-to-workforce platform that turns face recognition into auditable attendance workflows.
bullets: RTSP camera ingestion with GStreamer/NVDEC, InsightFace recognition, ArcFace embeddings, tracking, and identity voting.
Attendance windows, debounce, leave and explanation flows, approvals, snapshots, RBAC, and audit records.
FastAPI, Vue 3, PostgreSQL, Qdrant, Redis, RabbitMQ, MinIO, MJPEG/WebRTC, and SQL/RAG assistant.

items.label: CASE III
items.title: FaceSpeed Studio
items.summary: A local PDF voice-RAG studio with citation-aware answers, NVIDIA Riva speech, and a 3D avatar.
bullets: Docling ingestion, PostgreSQL metadata, Qdrant retrieval, embedding/reranking, and vLLM review.
Natural spoken answers keep citations inspectable instead of mixing source details into the conversation.
NVIDIA Riva TTS, Three.js/ReadyPlayer avatar playback, Nginx routing, service isolation, and benchmark evidence.

items.label: CASE IV
items.title: NTC Store AI Retail Agent
items.summary: A retail assistant that connects product, cart, policy, and conversation context through tools.
bullets: ReAct loops, tool registry, contract-validated observations, product/cart context, and account-scoped memory.
Qdrant policy retrieval for warranty and delivery questions, with streamed product-aware responses.
Next.js/React, NestJS/Fastify, PostgreSQL/Prisma, Redis, and a quality gate with response revision.

items.label: CASE V
items.title: Ambrouse AI Story Studio
items.summary: A local production workflow from chapter URLs to rewritten text, TTS audio, and rendered video.
bullets: Chapter collection, rewriting, cleanup, chunking, TTS, audio merge, project management, and progress tracking.
Portable Windows packaging, browser-provider bridge integration, native GPU rendering, and long-job streaming.
The product workflow and runtime hardening are custom; Browser Use and VieNeu-TTS are treated as integrations.
